title: VeriShield B2B Vendor KYB & Regulatory Compliance Audit Input

vendors.title: Vendors List (Bulk KYB & Domain Audit)
vendors.description: Array of vendor objects to verify across GLEIF (LEI), EU VIES (VAT), US SEC EDGAR (CIK/Ticker), HHS NPPES (NPI), and live domain security/compliance checks.

enableGleif.title: Check Global Legal Entity Identifier (GLEIF LEI)
enableGleif.description: Verify legal entity status, jurisdiction, registration authority, and HQ address against the official GLEIF database.

enableVies.title: Check European Commission VIES VAT Registry
enableVies.description: Validate EU/XI cross-border VAT numbers in real time via the official EU VIES system.

enableSec.title: Check US SEC EDGAR Filings & CIK
enableSec.description: Verify US publicly traded entities, CIK, SIC industry code, and recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings.

enableNppes.title: Check US HHS NPPES NPI Healthcare Registry
enableNppes.description: Verify US healthcare providers and medical suppliers in the official CMS NPPES NPI registry.

enableDomainAudit.title: Audit Corporate Domain (SPF, DMARC, NIS2 Headers, GDPR & EAA Signals)
enableDomainAudit.description: Inspect DNS email anti-spoofing records (SPF/DMARC/MX), HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), security.txt, and GDPR/EAA web compliance signals.

generateHtmlReport.title: Generate White-Label Executive HTML Compliance Certificates
generateHtmlReport.description: Store a print/PDF-ready HTML Executive Compliance Certificate in the Key-Value Store for each audited vendor.

whiteLabelBrandName.title: White-Label Brand Name (For Agency / Enterprise Reports)
whiteLabelBrandName.description: Custom company or compliance team name displayed at the top of generated HTML Compliance Certificates.
